no_api_findings.finding: The documented Rust 1.99.1 standard library has no JSON parser, tokenizer, or value type. The std, core, and alloc all-items pages (rustdoc 1.99.1) contain no occurrence of 'json' (case-insensitive). std::str::from_utf8 and std::io::Read validate or return bytes without interpreting JSON. rustc's internal JSON support (the former libserialize json module) is not part of the distributed standard library. No format-aware bundled API was available to run against controls/json/nested-object.json.

limit: This covers the documented Rust 1.99.1 standard library (core, alloc, std). External crates, rustc-internal crates, and native system libraries are separate. The finding is not yet merged into an aggregate standard inventory.
